# Out of Warranty

> Out of Warranty (Garanti Dışı) is a browser-based, turn-based 2D artillery game. Players command 34 robots, use 20 weapons, and fight across destructible arenas. It supports solo play against computer-controlled opponents, local hot-seat matches, and online rooms for up to six players.

## Play

- [Play Out of Warranty](https://bahattinercan.github.io/out-of-warranty/): game page, English and Turkish overview, and frequently asked questions.
